name: Reliance Securities Co.,Ltd.
summary: Reliance Securities Co.,Ltd., operating as a subsidiary of Sheng Yuan Ze Investment Limited Company, offers a comprehensive range of specialized investment solutions across Taiwan. Based in Taipei, the firm's diverse portfolio of services encompasses securities brokerage, futures, warrants, agency fund management, discretionary and various other entrustment arrangements, as well as underwriting and bond market activities. Furthermore, the company provides essential financial planning and advisory support to its clients.
